Mark a tracker step as failed

Source: R/progress_tracker.R
mysterycall_tracker_fail.Rd

Mark a tracker step as failed

Usage

mysterycall_tracker_fail(tracker, step, reason = NULL)

Arguments

tracker

Object created by mysterycall_progress_tracker().

step

Step name.

reason

Optional string describing why the step failed.

Value

The tracker object, invisibly.

See also

Other logging: mysterycall_format_duration(), mysterycall_log_cache_hit(), mysterycall_log_error(), mysterycall_log_info(), mysterycall_log_progress(), mysterycall_log_save(), mysterycall_log_step(), mysterycall_log_step_complete(), mysterycall_log_success(), mysterycall_log_to_file(), mysterycall_log_warning(), mysterycall_progress_callback(), mysterycall_progress_finish(), mysterycall_progress_start(), mysterycall_progress_summary(), mysterycall_progress_tracker(), mysterycall_tracker_update(), mysterycall_use_quiet_logging(), mysterycall_workflow_end(), mysterycall_workflow_start()

Examples

tr <- mysterycall:::mysterycall_progress_tracker(c("Geocode"), update_every = 1e9)
mysterycall:::mysterycall_progress_start(tr, "Geocode")
#> [01:33:15] Started Geocode
#> [01:33:15] Progress: 0/1 steps complete (0.0%)
mysterycall:::mysterycall_tracker_fail(tr, "Geocode", reason = "API timeout")
#> [01:33:15] Failed Geocode: API timeout
#> [01:33:15] Progress: 0/1 steps complete (0.0%)
